properties.notes: The site is located adjacent to Hextable urban confines. The existing access onto Crawfords could be utilised however it is narrow and may require improvement. Overall the southeastern portion of the site containing permanent buildings is considered able to accommodate development however it is located within the Green Belt so this designation would need to change in order for it to be developed.
